review_candidates.title: Regional Contract and Compliance Manager
review_candidates.description: Save lives, build safer futures. Are you an experienced international development professional with the expertise to manage complex donor contracts, strengthen compliance and build influential partnerships? Are you ready to use your skills to make a difference in communities affected by conflict and explosive violence? Location: Vietnam, with some regional travel Starting salary: £35,904 + £7,500 cost of living allowance Closing date: Monday 30 November 2026, 12 noon UK time We are looking for an accomplished Regional Contract and Compliance Manager to play a pivotal role in overseeing a capacity development contract in Vietnam and strengthening contract compliance across our programmes in East Asia and the Pacific. This is an exciting opportunity to combine strategic contract management, donor engagement, programme oversight and regional capacity development in a role where getting the detail right has a direct impact on delivering life-saving humanitarian work. Our role Based in Vietnam, you will divide your time between two key areas of responsibility: Contract Management - You will oversee the delivery and management of a US-funded capacity development contract with the Quang Tri Mine Action Centre (QTMAC), ensuring contractual commitments are met, performance is monitored, risks are managed and programme objectives are achieved. Working closely with MAG colleagues and partners, you will drive quality assurance, financial oversight, reporting, monitoring and evaluation, and support the long-term sustainability of the project. Regional Contract Compliance - You will provide specialist support to MAG programmes in Cambodia, Lao PDR, Papua New Guinea and Vietnam, strengthening compliance with US Department of State funding agreements. You will help develop consistent approaches to donor compliance, provide guidance and training, undertake quality assurance and share learning across the region, ensuring programmes meet the highest standards of accountability and delivery. Requirements We are looking for someone who can combine technical expertise with strong relationship-building skills, sound judgement and the confidence to operate at a senior level. You will bring: Strong donor contract management experience: A proven track record of overseeing donor-funded contracts, including delivery, contract management, performance monitoring and evaluation Senior humanitarian and development experience: Significant experience working on international development or humanitarian projects, with the ability to operate strategically and provide effective programme oversight Confident stakeholder representation: Experience representing an organisation with institutional donors, local and national government authorities, implementing partners and other key stakeholders Donor compliance expertise: A strong understanding of donor regulations, contractual obligations, project monitoring and evaluation, and compliance assurance. Experience with US Government-funded contracts, particularly US Department of State funding, would be a distinct advantage Partnership development and negotiation: A proven ability to establish and maintain successful relationships, influence stakeholders and negotiate effectively with donors, government bodies, NGOs and local partners You will also have the communication, analytical and organisational skills to translate complex donor requirements into practical guidance, strengthen programme systems and support colleagues to deliver with confidence. Benefits Renumeration Package is £43,404 GBP per annum annum including basic salary and all allowances and this increases with service. Accommodation: MAG will provide accommodation in-country. Leave: We recognise our staff work hard and need the appropriate time out to stay motivated. You'll have a minimum of six weeks out of the programme per year Flights: MAG provides three international flights home per year Insurance: Internationally contracted, programme based staff are automatically covered by MAG's comprehensive insurance package including: Personal accident and medical expenses insurance; Death by natural causes insurance and access to 24-hour medical assistance At MAG, this is more than a contract management role. It is an opportunity to use your professional expertise to support work that changes lives. Our teams work alongside communities to remove landmines and explosive remnants of war, reduce the impact of weapons and create safer environments where people can rebuild their lives without fear. You will be joining an international organisation driven by a shared commitment to: Determination - working with purpose Expertise - building trust through excellence Integrity - striving to do the right thing Compassion - putting people first Inclusion - valuing diversity and ensuring everyone has a voice Your contribution will help ensure that the resources entrusted to MAG are managed responsibly, partnerships are strengthened and humanitarian programmes deliver meaningful, sustainable results.

Acting as a trusted advisor to senior regional and global stakeholders, the Director shapes key business decisions and drives financial integrity. Own and elevate stakeholder experience, delivering high-quality, reliable accounting outcomes and balance sheet reviews. Act as the single point of accountability (for Global Technical Accounting, International FRA Head, Consolidations and Reporting function) for key accounting and reporting decisions and risk management across regions. Champion digital transformation, advancing automation and innovation in accounting and reporting. Strengthen controller capability, partnering with regions to build a high-performing, future-ready finance talent bench. Conduct deep-dive reviews of critical balance sheet and income statement areas, identifying opportunities to enhance consistency, transparency, and control. Align regional processes to support growth, ensuring effective coordination with Regional teams, Global functions, Consolidations and Reporting, and cross-functional stakeholders. Shape regional revenue recognition positions and drive alignment with Global Technical Accounting. Establish a robust risk identification and governance framework, ensuring timely escalation, resolution, and mitigation of key accounting risks across markets. Key partner to the Internal Controls function to strengthen controls across International markets. Embed a culture of innovation, continuously evaluating emerging tools and technologies to modernize the FRA function. Identify and prioritize opportunities to automate processes and leverage AI in core accounting and reporting activities. Lead implementation of digital initiatives by partnering with internal teams and external consultants, ensuring measurable efficiency and quality gains.
